situation (example wording): Every ranking answer ("Which states have the highest murder rate in 2024?", "Which cities in the United States had the most murders in 2024?", "Which counties in Texas ...", "Where does Houston rank in murder rate in 2024 in the state?", a Homicide Reports ranking of cities, "Which Texas cities had the most carjackings so far this year?", a Current Trends ranking) and every sentence that says a month has no data
what the app does today: A first line such as "Texas city agencies: the 22 with the most carjacking offenses, 2024.", then "Ranked: ...", "Not ranked because they didn't report all 12 months of 2024: names.", "No data is available for August 2026 to September 2026", "NIBRS has no reports from ... in this period.", and "From the FBI's Supplementary Homicide Reports: ...".
proposed behavior: A ranking answer opens with a Title Case title that reads back the question's own datapoints: the period, the measure, the grouping, the place and any condition the question carried ("2024 Murder Rate by State", "2024 Murder Count by City, Texas, Population 250,000 or More", "Where Houston Ranks on 2024 Murder Rate Among Texas Cities", "2026 Year to Date Carjacking Offenses by City, Texas"). The title never names a source and never says "Ranked". Under it, plain-sentence notes: how many are shown, who is ranked, ties, who is left out and why, the rate's basis; then the "Source: ..." line. Sentences about a month with no data say "data", not "report": "No data is available for August 2026 to September 2026", "No clearance rate is given: no data is available for March 2026.", "NIBRS has no data from the San Francisco Police Department in this period." The completeness rule reads "Only agencies with data for all 12 months of 2024 are ranked, and ties are ordered by agency name."; an agency left out reads "Austin Police Department isn't ranked because it has data for only 11 of the 12 months of 2024." (several: "A (11 months) and B (10 months) aren't ranked because data is missing for some of the 12 months of 2024."; more than five: "6 agencies aren't ranked because data is missing for some of the 12 months of 2024. The five with the largest populations are ..."). A quarter with some months missing: "Q2 2024 is shown blank, not as a whole quarter, because the agency has data for only some of its months." A Homicide Reports ranking: "Not every city has Homicide Reports data, and cities with no data in this period are not ranked." and "Counts are the homicides agencies reported to the FBI, each victim counted." Headlines of other answers ("{place}: ...") and the "Source: ..." lines stay.
exact default or choices offered: Title, then notes, then the source line.
why: Jeff 2026-11-17 (through the coordinator): "The title should basically read back the query's datapoints in plain english"; "2024 Murder Rate by State"; "Yes, title plus notes"; "Group A and B"; "Data instead of reports".
test cases: scripts/test-nibrs-historical.ts, scripts/test-nibrs-shr.ts and scripts/test-nibrs-shadow.ts (the ranking blocks).
